user.title: Add Onesti Lock
user.description: Select the Onesti lock to manage PIN codes for.

abort.zha_not_found: ZHA integration not found or not configured. This integration requires ZHA to decode custom Zigbee attribute reports for user identification. Zigbee2MQTT does not expose these events in the same way.
abort.no_devices_found: No Onesti Lock locks found in ZHA.

set_pin.title: Set PIN code
set_pin.description: Select slot, enter name and PIN code (4-8 digits). Slot numbers correspond to the lock's internal user slots (ZCL DoorLock). The list starts after the master slots set under Settings. Note: if the lock is asleep, the first attempt times out and the integration wakes the lock by sending a lock command. An unlocked door will be physically locked, so close the door before you start.

clear_pin.title: Clear PIN code
clear_pin.description: Select user to remove. If the lock is asleep, the integration wakes it by sending a lock command; an unlocked door will be physically locked.

name_slot.title: Name a user slot
name_slot.description: Assign a name to a slot number (0-999). Used for RFID tags, fingerprints, the master codes, or other access methods not set via the PIN menu. Leave the name empty to remove it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Nimly PRO, Touch Pro and Code reserve slots 0-2 for master codes: set 3. Nimly Code Pro reserves only slot 0: set 1. Slot 0 is never written from Home Assistant.

progress.set_pin_progress: Sending PIN code to the lock...
progress.clear_pin_progress: Clearing PIN code from the lock...

error.invalid_slot: Slot number must be between 0 and 999
error.lock_unreachable: Could not reach the lock. Press the keypad and try again.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the logs.

abort.no_active_slots: No active PIN codes to remove

lock_unreachable.message: Could not reach the lock. Press a button on the lock to wake it and try again.
